data.text: I’m in—no more than 10 tons for me this month. My family taught me that leaving fish in the lake protects everyone’s livelihood. Let’s use Emma’s recovery rule if stocks fall: split only what’s above 50 tons equally, and pause fishing if we’re at or below 50 until the lake recovers. We’ll review the stock and everyone’s catches together each month. Glad we’ve agreed on a way to keep this lake supporting the village.
